title: FCC Lattice Perturbation Theory and Beta Function

results.name: C1: b_0, b_1 precision and formula consistency
C2: FCC Laplacian normalization — formula gives (3/2)*k^2, NOT k^2
results.details: k^2 = 0.00075000. Formula hat{k}^2 = 0.00112498, ratio = 1.5000 (expected 1.5). Cubic hat{k}^2 = 0.00074998, ratio = 1.0000 (expected 1.0). Raw 1-cos sum = 0.00449972, ratio = 5.9996. CONFIRMS E4: formula needs 2/3 normalization factor.

results.name: C3: Tadpole integral — raw MC ≈ 0.088, NOT 0.1549
results.details: I_FCC (raw formula) = 0.0883 +/- 0.0001 (expected ~0.088). I_FCC (2/3 corrected) = 0.1325 +/- 0.0002. I_FCC (raw * 3/2) = 0.1325. I_cubic = 0.1547 +/- 0.0002 (exact = 0.15493). Raw matches 0.088: True. Raw matches 0.1549: False. CONFIRMS E5: claimed value 0.1549 is wrong for the formula as written.

results.name: C4: Boxed formula correct despite sign error in derivation
results.details: a values at betas [10, 20, 50, 100, 200]: ['2.4302e-05', '2.0749e-10', '7.9090e-26', '1.1152e-51', '1.6553e-103']. Monotone decreasing: True. a(200) < 1e-50: True. ln(a*Lambda) at beta=100: wrong sign = 119.63 (would give a->inf), correct sign = -119.63 (gives a->0). Boxed formula gives a(100) = 1.1152e-51: CORRECT.

results.name: C5: D_4 isotropy: Delta T_FCC = 0, Delta T_cubic != 0
results.details: D_4 neighbors: 24. Max |Delta T_FCC| = 4.44e-16 (machine precision). T_1111 = 3.0000 (expected 3.0000), T_1122 = 1.0000 (expected 1.0000). Cubic: max |Delta T| = 1.0000. FCC isotropic: True. Cubic anisotropic: True.

results.name: C6: D_4 coordination number is 24, not 12
results.details: D_4 minimal vectors: 24 (expected 24). All same length: True, norm = 1.4142. Count from mu<nu pairs: 24. The derivation §5.1 line 21-23 says '12' which is INCORRECT for D_4. 3D FCC has coordination 12; 4D D_4 has coordination 24.

results.name: C7: Asymptotic scaling — monotone, approaches zero, Lambda-independent
results.details: Monotone (2 to 50): True. a(200)/a(100) = 1.4844e-52 (approaches zero: True). Ratio Lambda-independent: True. N_f_critical = 16.5. b_0(16) = 0.002111 > 0, b_0(17) = -0.002111 < 0: AF correctly lost.

results.name: C8: Lambda ratio sensitivity — depends critically on I_FCC
results.details: Scenario 1 (I=0.1549, dv=0.023): Lambda_FCC/MSbar = 34.0. Scenario 2 (I=0.088, dv=0.023): Lambda_FCC/MSbar = 38.1. Scenario 3a (I=0.1549, dv=0): Lambda_FCC/MSbar = 28.8. Scenario 3b (I=0.088, dv=0): Lambda_FCC/MSbar = 32.3. Scenario 4 (I=0.132 corrected, dv=0.023): Lambda_FCC/MSbar = 35.3. The Lambda ratio varies from 28.8 to 38.1 across scenarios.

results.name: C9: delta_vertex = 0.023 — plausible but UNVERIFIED
results.details: delta_vertex = 0.023. Dimensionless: YES. Within plausible range (0.001, 0.1): True. Natural scale alpha_s/(4pi)*0.1 ~ 0.0239. Impact on Lambda ratio: factor 1.180 (18.0%). WARNING: This is the DOMINANT contribution to the FCC vs cubic Lambda difference and needs a proper derivation.

results.name: C10: Dashen-Gross ratio = Lambda_MSbar/Lambda_L = 28.8
results.details: Standard Dashen-Gross: Lambda_MSbar/Lambda_lattice = 28.81. Prefactor = 38.852704, exp factor = 0.7415. This means Lambda_MSbar > Lambda_lattice (standard direction). The proof writes 'Lambda_cubic/Lambda_MSbar = 28.8' which is the INVERSE of the standard convention. This needs clarification — the Lambda ratio formula in Part (d) may use the inverted ratio internally, and the final result Lambda_FCC/Lambda_MSbar ~ 34.0 should be Lambda_MSbar/Lambda_FCC ~ 34.0.

results.name: C11: D_4 BZ volume ratio to cubic = 8.00
results.details: D_4 basis det = 0.1250. BZ volume = 12468.36, cubic BZ = 1558.55. Ratio = 8.00. The MC integration over [-pi,pi]^4 may need volume correction if BZ ratio != 1. This affects the tadpole integral computation.

results.name: C12: beta* = 34.0 (claimed ~34.1)
results.details: a_CG = 3.6408e-35 m = 3.6408e-20 fm. Lambda_FCC = 11.6 GeV. a*Lambda = 2.1329e-18. beta* = 34.01 (claimed ~34.1). Deep perturbative: True.
